scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/server && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/server && node --test apps/server/dist/schedule.test.js apps/server/dist/clock.test.js apps/server/dist/whatsapp.test.js && npm run test:polling
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/server && node --env-file=.env scripts/test-integration.cjs
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:check && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:generate && npm run build
